title: Change food_stuff_tp tuple to food_stuff_lt list
description:
Change the about food_stuff_tp tuple to a food_stuff_lt list.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as food_stuff_to_list(food_stuff_tp), where food_stuff_tp is a tuple, returning food_stuff_lt as a list with the same items in the same order.
hints: Converting between the two main ordered sequence types in Python is a one-function job.
You used tuple() earlier to go from list to tuple - this is the same idea in the opposite direction.
Return list(food_stuff_tp) - the list() built-in converts a tuple into a list with the same items and order.
expected_behavior: Returns food_stuff_tp converted to a list, preserving item order.
explanation: list() accepts any iterable, including a tuple, and builds a new list containing the same elements in the same order, since lists (unlike tuples) can be mutated afterward.
